title: Quarter-Round Low Stage Corner
description: One newly authored quarter-round low-stage outside corner, counted as one static modular asset. The continuous solid 100 mm deck has two orthogonal 1 m radial ports, a true 24-facet quarter-circular outside edge, and a 0.37 m top. One continuous thick triangular open underframe is supported by three complete square posts on three finite flat feet. All seven internal joints are complete opposed finite faces; no hidden penetration is used. Metres, native Z up, corner-port ground origin at (0,0,0), three opaque unlinked constant PBR materials. Only two explicitly tested fixed placements of the pinned music-stage-platform-01 are in scope: centres (-1.005,0.5,0), rotation 0, and (0.5,-1.005,0), rotation 90 degrees. They retain the actual four original bevelled boards and full underframes, with a nominal 10 mm separation joint and matching 0.37 m top; neighbour copies exist only for QA and are never exported. Port separation is not a contact or seamlessness claim. Not an overlapping rectangular-stage pair, recolour, scaled transport platform, or entire stage scene. Static visual geometry only: no stage loading, slip resistance, stability, activity safety, manufacture, installation, human-use, arbitrary layout, transport/rail compatibility, collision or navigation claim.
